Term deposits

Lock in your rate. Watch it grow.

Choose a term between 30 days and 5 years. Interest is calculated daily and you choose what happens when your deposit matures.

  • Minimum deposit K1,000; above K100,000, ask for a tailored high-yield quote
  • Tiered interest rates, calculated daily
  • Interest paid at maturity, or quarterly for terms of one year or more
  • For individuals, enterprises and trusts: bring valid ID and proof of address
  • Early withdrawal is generally not permitted; if agreed, a penalty interest rate applies under BPNG guidelines
Open a term deposit

Full auto-rollover

Reinvest both your principal and interest into a new term deposit.

Partial auto-rollover

Reinvest only the principal or only the interest, and transfer the rest to your account.

Full payout

Transfer both principal and interest to your nominated account.

Give us your instructions at least 7 days before maturity. If we don't hear from you, your deposit rolls over for the same term at the prevailing rate.

iDisclaimer
Interest is calculated daily on the number of days in the term. It is paid at maturity for terms under one year, and quarterly for terms of one year or more. Figures shown are gross, before 15% interest withholding tax where applicable. If maturity falls on a non-business day, funds are available on the next business day.

The term deposit calculator is provided for general information only. NBCL does not guarantee the accuracy or completeness of the results generated, which are an estimate based on the amount and term you select and NBCL's advertised interest rate at the time of use. Interest rates are subject to change, and the rate applied to your deposit is the rate prevailing at the time the deposit is placed. Figures shown are gross and do not account for interest withholding tax, which is deducted at 15% unless an exemption applies. Early redemption before maturity is at NBCL's discretion, is subject to a penalty interest rate and will reduce the interest earned. NBCL and its agents accept no liability for any direct, indirect or consequential loss arising from use of or reliance on this calculator.

Questions

Savings FAQs

How do I earn the full 4% on Future Saver?+

You earn the 1% p.a. base rate every month, plus a 3% p.a. bonus for any calendar month with no withdrawals.

Can I withdraw from Little Learner?+

Yes. Withdrawals are free in December and January, when school fees are due. Withdrawals from February to November cost K5 each.

How is a term deposit different from a savings account?+

A term deposit locks in a fixed rate for a fixed term. A savings account gives you flexible access, with interest calculated on your balance.

What happens when my term deposit matures?+

Choose full rollover, partial rollover or full payout at least 7 days before maturity. If we don't hear from you, it rolls over for the same term at the prevailing rate.

Are there special rates for large deposits?+

Yes. For deposits above K100,000 we offer tailored high-yield quotes to suit your liquidity needs.
